title: skills: objectstack-query claims the business question sent over MCP that objectstack-ask owns (description and trigger case 3)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1ZJL93Kin2UHFXbFv

Filing gate ②: a follow-up from the #34769 measurement round (PR #35857), filed on the seat's ruling (seat 4, 2026-11-20 12:47Z, option A). It was first raised as S1 in contract review 7028002670 on #35709. Dedupe: searched `objectstack-query MCP objectstack-ask trigger`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2. Shipped skill text routes a governed-metric business question to the wrong bundle, so an agent skips ask's governed-metric procedure.

## What

- `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md`'s description says "Use when … shaping a records query or aggregation sent over MCP".
- `skills/objectstack-query/evals/triggers.json` case 3 (a business question asked over an ObjectStack MCP connection) expects query to load.
- `objectstack-ask` claims the same request. In the round `/mnt/project-files/area-ai-seat/a4-A/evals/34769-triggers-20261120/` (haiku, effort medium), the head-to-head with both bundles installed (12 turns, `s1-head-to-head/`) gave **objectstack-ask launched 12/12, objectstack-query launched or read 0/12**. That held on #35857's branch and on 18.6.0's bundles. With query alone installed, case 3 loaded before #35709 and did not load after.

## Ask

1. Drop the "sent over MCP" clause from query's description, and name `objectstack-ask` in query's "Not for" (the business question / governed metric). Pay for it in place inside the description length and the token ceiling.
2. Flip query trigger case 3 to `should_trigger: false`, or reword it to shaping a query in code so that it stays a query positive. Keep the MCP business question as an ask positive: `skills/objectstack-ask/evals/triggers.json` case 1 is that prompt verbatim, added by #35857.
3. Add the changeset `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

## Done when

- Query's description no longer claims the MCP business question and names objectstack-ask.
- Case 3 no longer expects query on it.
- `check-skills-token-ratchet` passes with no ceiling raise, and `check:skill-docs` is in sync.

Relations: follow-up of #34769 (its S1). It touches the same `SKILL.md` frontmatter family as #35709. Lane: skills (`skills/objectstack-query/**`), a4-A.
Blocked-by: #35857 (it adds the ask trigger cases that this card leans on)
